summary: Verified 7.0/10: NOT ON PAR (bar 7.5), no blocker open. Build state confirmed: git diff 874f3f6d1..HEAD on art/out/fighters/ardit is empty (GF-1 regrade reverted in 89112e613), so three_ardit.png (Nov 6 08:41) and the reviewer's fresh clip sheet show the shipped model. In the match (closing_ardit_r2_match_close.png) he reads as a pale flat-capped block with a pale pane against the brown lane. The one major stands: the splash and portrait are a posterized game-model render pasted on a painted plate. The face is a blocky orange slab under a blue slit, and figure and plate do not share a light (splash.png, closing_ardit_splash_upper_x2.png). All five minors reproduce. I re-ran chain_motion on the run clip and got exactly the cited numbers. Sensitivity is clean: flat box crown, no hood, the visor is one horizontal blue bar (not an eye pair), and nothing reads as horror or a mannequin. One correction: the claim that a nose and mouth read 'in every skin' is too strong, because on the Chalkline splash the spire tip covers the face (closing_ardit_chalk_upper_x2.png). Not a sensitivity issue.

findings.title: Splashes and portraits are a filtered game-model render pasted on a painted plate, not an illustration
findings.what:
Each skin has its own staging, but the figure is still the in-game model run through a posterize filter:
- Face: a blocky orange slab under the blue slit.
- Light: the figure is warm-lit on a cool plate.
- Overlap: the Chalkline spire tip crosses the visor.
- First Bell portrait: the pane fills about half the frame and pushes the face to the left.
findings.evidence: art/out/fighters/ardit/splash.png; _harness/_shots/closing_ardit_splash_upper_x2.png; _harness/_shots/closing_ardit_chalk_upper_x2.png; art/out/fighters/ardit/ardit_first_bell_portrait.png; _harness/_reports/closing_ardit_cards.json (figure hpRMS 5.33-7.05 vs sky 0.25; splash MAD 35.3/37.0)
findings.gauge: LoL splash and portrait art is a bespoke painting: the face is the focal point, rendered cleanly, and figure and background share one light and one finish.
findings.fix: Render the subject clean at 2x with no posterize pass. Add a VALE paint-over pass in the plate's palette, with a rim light from the plate's sun and a key light on the face inside the visor. Reframe the Chalkline splash and the First Bell portrait. Make it a shared option in render.py / plates.py.
findings.verifierNote: I looked at the images myself and the defect is plain at 1x. It is not a blocker, because the cards are legible and on-model. Major is the right severity.

findings.title: Muster (ult) key pose is small and lacks the brief's planted-pane silhouette
findings.what: In cast_ult the spear goes diagonal across the body and the pane stays at his left side. Nothing is planted in front and he never steps behind it.
findings.gauge: A LoL ultimate's cast pose is the champion's most distinct silhouette change at the gameplay camera.
findings.fix: Re-key cast_ult in Ardit's own way: plant the pane in front, step behind it, hold f16-f30. Gate it with a silhouette IoU vs idle below 0.6.
findings.verifierNote: Reproduced. It could be argued up to major against the gauge, but the ult's beacon VFX carries the in-game read, so it stays minor.

findings.title: Tabard strip crosses in front of the pane in dash and Lancing Run
findings.what: The left tabard panel draws as a white strip across the lower pavise.
findings.gauge: LoL cloth does not visibly pass through a held shield at the game camera.
findings.fix: Clamp the tabard_l seg1 forward swing in dash/cast_a1, or push the chain behind the pane plane, then re-run chain_motion.

findings.title: Wire strands on the cuirass back above the belt
findings.what: Dark hairline strands and jagged facets above the belt, visible only in close-ups.
findings.gauge: A LoL model holds up in lobby and collection close-ups.
findings.fix: Remove the torso.sub torus grooves and paint the band as a value line in the albedo, or shrinkwrap the torus inside the cuirass.

findings.title: Height and highest point off-brief
findings.what: He is 2.476 m / 134 px against the brief's 2.35 m / 119 px, and the spear tip, not the spire, is the highest point.
findings.gauge: A LoL silhouette hook is deliberately the top element seen from the camera.
findings.fix: Lower the idle spear grip, or amend the brief and record the choice in owner_rulings.md.
findings.verifierNote: I confirmed art.json and the brief. Mostly a doc/model mismatch.

findings.title: Lower tabard segments snap up to 30 deg per frame in the run
findings.what: seg2/seg3 step 30.3/25.7 deg (left) and 27.8/21.5 deg (right) in one frame. Swing ranges are 72/64 and 87/50 deg.
findings.evidence: My re-run of art/tools/chain_motion.py art/out/fighters/ardit/ardit.glb --clip run --chain tabard_l --ref thigh.L (and tabard_r/thigh.R) gave identical numbers.
findings.gauge: LoL cloth secondaries ease in and out with no single-frame pops.
findings.fix: Add more damping to seg2/seg3 or smooth them with a 3-tap filter, and add a 15 deg per-frame step limit to the gate.
